ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior when the block is not found
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard JSON-RPC error handling applies when block number references a non-existent block. Return null or error per existing eth_getBlockByNumber semantics.

ambiguities.text: The specification says blocks 'before' the fork must not include baseFee, but does not clarify edge case of exactly the fork block
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'on or after' the fork block means block.number >= FORK_BLOCK includes baseFee. The fork block itself should include baseFee.

implicit_assumptions.description: The node has accurate knowledge of the EIP-1559 fork block number for the active chain
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect baseFee field inclusion/exclusion could confuse clients about block age or fork status

implicit_assumptions.description: The baseFee value in the block header is correctly computed and stored during block processing
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Clients would receive incorrect base fee information, potentially affecting gas price estimation
